recentItems.title: IDF On High Alert! Houthis Planning Surprise Israel Attack Amid Monster Strikes On Key Saudi Infra?
recentItems.description:
IDF On High Alert! Houthis Planning Surprise Israel Attack Amid Monster Strikes On Key Saudi Infra?

As fighting between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia intensifies, Israeli defence officials are increasingly concerned that the Yemen-based group could attempt a surprise assault on Israel — either by land or by sea. The IDF is stepping up its preparations, keeping rapid-response forces on alert near Eilat and strengthening coordination between its ground, naval and air units. But what is raising alarm in Israel is the possibility that the conflict could escalate further, opening up a new and unpredictable front.
Israel is taking no chances. According to report, Israeli defense officials believe the Houthis may have been working to improve their ability to launch attacks from both land and sea.

recentItems.title: Karnataka HC Quashes SC/ST Quota Hike: DKS To Move SC? Sidda Blames BJP As Judge Rejects 'EWS' Logic
recentItems.description:
The Karnataka High Court has struck down the state's law increasing SC reservation from 15% to 17% and ST reservation from 3% to 7%, taking total reservation to 56%. The court reaffirmed the 50% ceiling, rejecting the state's justification for exceeding it. The Karnataka government is considering its next legal move.

recentItems.title: Pakistan: Unknown Gunman Kills LeT Commander With ISI 'Link' In Broad Daylight, CCTV Video Shows...
recentItems.description:
A viral CCTV-style video allegedly shows an unknown gunman shooting a suspected Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) operative in Pakistan’s Punjab province in broad daylight. Social media claims link the alleged target to Pakistan’s ISI, but the victim’s identity, the location and the circumstances of the shooting remain unverified. No official confirmation has been cited.
